items.source: By default, this converter can read all media types that are supported by the registered image readers, and writes using the media type of the first available registered image writer. The latter can be overridden by setting the defaultContentType property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此转换器可以读取由 已注册的图像读取器 支持的所有媒体类型，并使用第一个可用的 已注册的图像写入器 的媒体类型进行写入。后者可以通过设置 defaultContentType 属性来覆盖。

items.source: The process(ImageReadParam) and process(ImageWriteParam) template methods allow subclasses to override Image I/O parameters.
items.translation: `process(ImageReadParam)` 和 `process(ImageWriteParam)` 模板方法允许子类覆盖图像 I/O 参数。

items.source: If the cacheDir property is set, this converter will cache image data.
items.translation: 如果设置了 `cacheDir` 属性，此转换器将缓存图像数据。

items.source: The default implementation is empty.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。

items.source: Returns the default Content-Type to be used for writing. Called when write(BufferedImage, MediaType, HttpOutputMessage) is invoked without a specified content type parameter.
items.translation: 返回用于写入的默认 `Content-Type`。 当调用 write(BufferedImage, MediaType, HttpOutputMessage) 且未指定内容类型参数时，会执行此操作。

items.source: Return the list of media types supported by this converter. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canWrite(clazz, null. The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific class. Alternatively, use HttpMessageConverter.getSupportedMediaTypes(Class) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此转换器支持的媒体类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canWrite(clazz, null 进行保护。该列表也可能仅排除特定类支持的 MIME 类型。或者，使用 HttpMessageConverter.getSupportedMediaTypes(Class) 获取更精确的列表。

items.source: contentType - the content type to use when writing. May be null to indicate that the default content type of the converter must be used. If not null, this media type must have previously been passed to the canWrite method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: contentType - 写入时使用的内容类型。若为 null，表示必须使用转换器默认的内容类型。若非 null，此媒体类型必须已先前传递给该接口的 canWrite 方法，且该方法必须返回 true。

items.source: clazz - the type of object to return. This type must have previously been passed to the canRead method of this interface, which must have returned true.
items.translation: clazz - 要返回的对象类型。此类型必须先前已传递给该接口的canRead方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to read (can be null if not specified); typically the value of a Content-Type header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要读取的媒体类型（如果未指定，可以为 `null`）；通常是 `Content-Type` 标头的值。

items.source: mediaType - the media type to write (can be null if not specified); typically the value of an Accept header.
items.translation: `mediaType` - 要写入的媒体类型（如果未指定，可以为 `null`）；通常是 `Accept` 头的值。
